label: CompactLogix 5380 2MB Enet controller
description: CompactLogix 5380 EtherNet/IP controller (2 MB, 16 local I/Os, 40 EtherNet/IP nodes) with exactly 2 x 1 Gb EtherNet ports on embedded RJ45 connectors, usable as a device-level ring (DLR) pair. There is also a USB port for local programming, which is not a network interface.
